choice: PR files and the Linear risky-change read are kept per (kind, repo, number) and reused while head sha and base ref match; None or a raise is not kept; entries for PRs not read this cycle are dropped in end_cycle
why: a PR's diff paths change only with its head or base, so a head-keyed cache removes the per-cycle files read without missing a push; labels and label events stay uncached because they change without a push

choice: CycleClock with a fixed PHASES table; PollLoop prints a start and an end line per cycle, the end line written in a finally and a phase that raised marked !; tracked-read carries per-source seconds
why: one table shared by the log line and the tests; the end line survives a failing phase so the slow phase is always visible

choice: after-poll is timed as one phase in PollLoop.run, not split into backup, dashboard-push and merge-kick
why: keeps lib/cli.py free for the ac-4 push timer; the dashboard push now also runs off-cycle, so the split adds little
the job runs on the Mac with no orch.yml or orch.db for the box; the simulated budget test (7 PRs, 66 s per timed-out files read) stands in, and the reviewer or Max can run it on the box

choice: the version also carries the pull's base sha
why: a base push can change the PR diff without moving the head or the base ref, and a configured path hold must see that diff

choice: an entry is dropped only after HEAD_READ_IDLE_SECONDS (12 x STOPPED_POLL_SECONDS) unread, not when one cycle skips it
why: the dispatcher skips stopped tickets between five-minute reads, so not-read-this-cycle is not not-tracked; an idle limit bounds memory without plumbing tracking state into the source
